item.title: Decentralized Git & Github Alternatives
item.description: As touched upon in my previous impromptu post, GitHub recently either suspended or deleted my account. Exactly which is which I don’t know - I’m still yet to receive an email, notification, or response to my ticket even acknowledging that anything happened. All I know is that late Friday afternoon I tried logging in and the login page kept redirecting me to a /suspended url that otherwise looked like a login page, and all of my data was completely inaccessible.
